title: Template Variables 📦
ques: In a Django template, how do you **output the value** of a variable named `username` passed from the view?
explanation: Double curly braces **`{{ }}`** are used to print the value of a variable in Django templates.

title: Template Tags 🏷️
ques: Write a **for loop** in Django template syntax to iterate over a list `items` and display each item in an `<li>` tag.

answer.content:
{% for item in items %}
  • {{ item }}
    • {% endfor %}

explanation: Template tags are surrounded by **`{% %}`**. The `for` tag facilitates looping, and it must be closed with `{% endfor %}`.

title: Template Inheritance 🧬
ques: Explain the purpose of the **`{% block %}`** and **`{% extends %}`** tags in Django template inheritance.

answer.content:
*   **`{% extends "base.html" %}`**: Put at the top of a child template, it tells Django that this template "extends" a parent template (e.g., `base.html`).
*   **`{% block name %}...{% endblock %}`**: Defines a block of content that can be overridden by child templates. The parent defines the block, and the child fills it in.

explanation: Inheritance allows you to build a base "skeleton" template containing all the common elements of your site and define **blocks** that child templates can override.

title: Loading Static Files 🎨
ques: Show how to **load the static tag library** and include a CSS file named `style.css` located in the `css` folder.
explanation: You must first Load the static library using **`{% load static %}`**. Then, use the `static` tag to generate the absolute URL to the file.
